The '''M'dweshuu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[M'dweshuu]], which went supernova tens of thousands of years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LoNH" />
